coordinate_semantics: monitoring-authoritative latitude/longitude from the canonical Crab Team site table; ShoreZone nearest match is contextual only

habitat_proxy.semantics: Beta(1,1)-smoothed site-year observed-detection probability by Crab Team habitat class on calibration years; MODEL PROXY, not latent habitat suitability

shorezone_rule.site_138: nearest thematic ShoreZone match rejected because distance exceeds accepted threshold; monitoring coordinate remains authoritative

formal_benchmark_rule: Spatial world models B/E must use the versioned monitoring coordinates. Family C must use the frozen habitat proxy above rather than a neutral placeholder. No raw PAMA outcomes may enter any green-crab belief/world model.
claim_guardrail: These coordinates and habitat classes anchor simulation context; the habitat proxy is an observation-derived design proxy, not ecological ground truth.
